data.name: Joscelin
data.gender_notes: Joscelin is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Old French 'Joscelin', meaning 'Joseph the healer'. In Christian tradition, this name is associated with the biblical Joseph, who was given the name 'Joseph' because it meant 'God will add [another son] to you'. The name Joscelin carries the symbolism of God's healing power and divine intervention. The name Joscelin carries the meaning “God's healer” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Joscelin usually hope their child will grow to embody god's healer and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name rooted in faith and divine healing
data.etymology: Joscelin belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “God's healer.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Joscelin total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

in_hebrew.name: יוסקלין
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם יוסקלין הוא שילוב של השמות העבריים יוסף ואלוהים, שפירושו 'אלוהים יוסיף' או 'אלוהים יגדיל'. השם נגזר מהשורשים העבריים 'יוסף' ו'אל', שפירושם 'להוסיף' ו'אלוהים', בהתאמה. השם מראה על גדלות ועל התוסף האלוהי בחיים.

in_greek.name: Γιοσκέλιν
in_greek.meaning: Ο Θεός προσθέτει, Ο Θεός μεγαλώνει
in_greek.long_meaning: Το όνομα Γιοσκέλιν είναι σύνθεση των ελληνικών ονομάτων Ιωσήφ και Θεός, που σημαίνει 'Ο Θεός προσθέτει' ή 'Ο Θεός μεγαλώνει'. Το όνομα προέρχεται από τις ελληνικές ρίζες 'Ιωσήφ' και 'Θεός', που σημαίνει 'προσθέτω' και 'Θεός', αντίστοιχα. Το όνομα δείχνει τη μεγαλοσύνη και την προσθήκη του Θεού στη ζωή.

in_latin.name: Joscelin
